root_cause_findings.detail: The historical source-year proxy now keys adult and youth Turkey separately by family and draw-pool identity, preserving their official resident and nonresident quotas. Regression coverage reproduces TK1003's 250-adult versus 37-youth resident split.

Turkey now removes deterministic max-pool winners before evaluating each successive weighted permit from the remaining finite applicant pool. It no longer compounds independent repeated chances for the same application.

The retained 2018-2022 official bear PDFs have separate resident and nonresident point ladders. The hash-linked extraction recombines exactly for all five canonical years after the 2018 canonical was repaired from its previously omitted official Black Bear report. The 2021-to-2022 source-only lane fold found and repaired an audit-only historical-proxy defect that summed broad residency columns from both normalized lane rows, doubling the max/random permit allocation. The repaired 2021-to-2022 deterministic Bear fold has 1,205 applicant-bearing rows, MAE 0.3238575487, and 53 false guarantees. The archived classifier now preserves the retained PDF page classification only on an official residency-lane audit projection, never from a prefix, quota, or generic legacy label. The repaired 2018-to-2019, 2019-to-2020, and 2020-to-2021 folds emit 3,600, 4,464, and 4,176 deterministic Bear rows across 75, 93, and 87 hunt codes. Their held-out scoreable rows/MAE/false guarantees are 31/0.4047964029/0, 1,168/0.3241954934/61, and 1,248/0.3566033402/98. This resolves archive classification coverage, not certification; no high-point demand or retention adjustment is authorized. Combined history must never be treated as a resident or nonresident ladder.

A copied source-year probability of 100 percent now emits an explicit NOT_SCORED guardrail rather than a next-year p_draw value. Lower copied values remain visibly source-backed roll-forward evidence and are not represented as a simulated lane.

draw_design_routing.rule: Classify the official source-backed draw design first, then invoke only that design family's mechanics. No universal probability formula may replace design routing.

max_weighted_bonus.note: BEAR_DRAW is a routing container. Only source-classified limited-entry hunting and restricted-pursuit rows enter bonus probability math. Harvest-objective hunting and general pursuit are availability programs.

random_only.note: These probabilities pass through the mixed layer unchanged.

youth_set_aside.note: Youth is not one generic engine; each youth row remains in its source-classified reserve, random-only, set-aside, or availability lane.

non_draw_availability_allocation.probability_policy: p_draw and all draw-pool probability fields must remain null

pending_or_review.probability_policy: Do not guess a design or fabricate probability

residency_rule_layer.forecast_policy: Use the explicit official resident/nonresident split first. Apply a total-derived split only for a draw family with an allowlisted source-backed allocation rule. Unsupported total-only families block; historical winner share is never current quota authority.

applicant_behavior_model.weight_policy: Use family, residency, point-band, and cutoff-structure retention learned only from prior-year transitions. Select final weights by blind following-year accuracy, not an untested fixed multiplier.

post_family_calibration_owner.responsibility: Calibrates eligible design-family outputs using prior-year behavior, official quota, applicant rollover, and capped harvest demand pressure; passes Sportsman and random-only outputs through unchanged and never creates probability for non-draw rows

family_routing_owner.responsibility: Authoritative draw-design taxonomy, routing, family-specific probability rules, exclusions, allocation, and availability semantics

forecast_materialization_owner.responsibility: Historical cohort forecast, uncertainty, design-family orchestration, backtest materialization, and prediction artifact packaging; directory name does not make it the engine for every draw design

deterministic_rules_owner.responsibility: Utah draw mechanics, deterministic simulation, demand and quota foundations, validation, and base materialization

current_hunt_and_permit_reference.role_boundary: Current DWR Hunt Planner identity and permit-reference context only; it is not historical draw-result truth and cannot replace yearly canonicals or draw_results_long.csv for prediction scoring.

hunt_research_management_context.role_boundary: Exact-code, compatible-species DWR management context for visitor display only. Synthetic statewide unit targets and boundary_id identity are prohibited; target/current comparisons require matching units.

hunt_quality_profile.role_boundary: Display-only U.O.G.A. composite. It is not a DWR score or prediction input, never reweights missing components, and cannot change draw probability, permits, quotas, or canonical truth.

truth_authority.scoring_rule: Only official scorable actual draw rows with retained lineage may determine prediction accuracy

runtime_artifacts.role_boundary: One sanitized selected-hunt ladder at a time; only certified_p_draw fields may expose future probability.
Visitor-facing raw harvest, exact management, and evidence-gated quality-profile fields layered over an unchanged protected draw/permit/quota projection.
